title: Machine-learning a family of solutions to an optimal pension investment problem
abstract: arXiv:2511.07045v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We use a neural network to identify the optimal solutions to a family of pension investment problems, where the parameters determining an investor's risk and consumption preferences are given as inputs to the neural network in addition to economic variables. Training a single network across such a family fails without modification. Our main contribution is a scaling of the loss function that resolves this, together with a proof that the resulting algorithm converges. We use this to develop a practical tool for exploring how pension outcomes vary with preference parameters. We use a Black-Scholes economic model so that we may validate the accuracy of the network using a classical and provably convergent numerical method developed using the duality approach.

translated_title: 机器学习求解最优养老金投资问题的一族解
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2511.07045v2 公告类型：替换版。摘要：我们使用神经网络来识别一族养老金投资问题的最优解，其中决定投资者风险和消费偏好的参数与经济变量一起作为神经网络的输入。在未经修改的情况下，仅训练一个网络来处理整个族的问题会失败。我们的主要贡献是对损失函数进行缩放以解决此问题，并证明了由此产生的算法的收敛性。我们利用这一点开发了一个实用工具，用于探索养老金结果如何随偏好参数变化。我们采用Black-Scholes经济模型，以便使用基于对偶方法的经典且可证明收敛的数值方法来验证网络的准确性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过缩放损失函数使神经网络能够有效求解一族养老金投资问题的方法，并证明了算法收敛性，同时开发了探索偏好参数影响的实用工具。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a loss-function scaling method that enables neural networks to effectively solve a family of pension investment problems, proves the convergence of the resulting algorithm, and develops a practical tool for exploring how preference parameters affect pension outcomes.
